title: NROL-16 on Walpurgisnacht, matching a Necronomicon rite

tellings.quote: The launch itself happened on 12:50 a.m. on April 30th, 2005. This happens to be the same day of Walpurgisnacht,

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that a US spy satellite launch called NROL-16 lifted off at 12:50 a.m. on April 30, 2005. He notes that this is Walpurgisnacht, a European folk night linked with witches, and, drawing on a man named John Ramirez, says the timing matches a rite in the Necronomicon, a book of supposed magic rituals. If true, it would hint that ritual timing plays a part in secret space launches.
